title: Conformal-Controlled Adaptive Filtering: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Bounds and Coverage-Driven Step-Size Control
description: Official open-source release v1.2.0 for Conformal-Controlled Adaptive Filtering (CCAF). Includes complete simulation pipelines, baseline algorithms (NLMS, RLS, VSS, Convex Combination), real-world physical benchmarks (Microsoft AEC Challenge, Aachen AIR 1.4, PhysioNet MIT-BIH, EEGdenoiseNet), and Android edge mobile deployment (APK v1.2.0).
